contexts.text: They turned their bodies from right to left and from left to right, like a cylinder.
By circumvolutions backwards and forwards, like the laminae round a cylinder.

It was perceived by spiritual ideas how the Church relates to the heart and lungs, by means of a cylinder or axis, in the middle of which were the celestial things of love, and spiritual things round about...
One of (these profaners) had a wheel-like disk round a tube...
